metadata.description: Watchkeeper for Claude Code: tool guards, a spend ledger for the headless runs it starts, an evidence gate on 'done', a kill switch and a steward you can schedule, with a panel for Antigravity and editors built on VS Code. Keeps its data in local files; sends nothing to Nexodyne; no telemetry.

plugins.name: watchkeeper
plugins.description: Guards, a spend ledger and an evidence gate for Claude Code: a lean start-up, path and secret guards, gated mail, publishing, money and purchases, a nudge back on a 'done' with no test behind it, a kill switch, a ledger of the headless runs it starts, and a steward you can schedule that paces itself on your plan's weekly limit. Optional task queue for Gemini in Antigravity. Keeps its data in local files; sends nothing to Nexodyne; no telemetry.
